description: This C# source file defines a static class RelationalStorageExtensions containing extension methods for the IRelationalStorage interface, providing functionalities such as executing multiple inserts, reading data asynchronously with reflection, executing commands, and retrieving streams from data readers.

classes.name: RelationalStorageExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for working with IRelationalStorage, including executing batched inserts, reading data with reflection, executing commands, and streaming data.

methods.name: ExecuteMultipleInsertIntoAsync
methods.description: Performs a multi-record insert into a specified table using either parameterized queries or inline values, supporting optional name mapping and 'only once' column optimization.

methods.name: ReadAsync<TResult>
methods.description: Async method to execute a query and project results into a list of TResult using a selector function and reflection-based parameter handling.

methods.name: ReadAsync<TResult> (overload)
methods.description: Simplified version of ReadAsync that executes a query without parameters.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes a command with specified parameters and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Returns a stream for a column in a data reader, attempting native support or providing a chunked fallback.
